description: One row per registered customer. Contains customer identity, location, and registration date.
use_cases: Finding customers by country or city
Joining to orders to find high-value customers

columns.customer_id: Primary key — unique identifier for each customer (INTEGER or UUID)
columns.name: Full name of the customer (TEXT)
columns.email: Email address — unique across all customers (TEXT)
columns.country: Country the customer is located in (TEXT, e.g. 'United States', 'Germany')
columns.city: City the customer is located in (TEXT)

sample_questions: How many customers do we have from each country?
Who are our top 10 customers by total spending?
How many new customers signed up last month?
